TNAU Recommended Treatment Protocol:

🌿 Organic Bio-Control:

🛵 The Urban Farm-To-Doorstep Cold Bridge

Connecting Rural Farmers to Urban Customers via City Cold Hubs

Metropolitan centers like Chennai (Koyambedu & Basin Bridge) and Coimbatore (Singanallur) have dense consumer populations with no nearby agricultural fields. AgriBRIDGE stages rural farm harvests in government urban cold hubs (maintaining 4°C–8°C), enabling local urban delivery partners to pick up batches on demand and deliver directly to residential consumers and restaurants.

🚜 ➔ 🚛
1. Rural Farm Dispatch
Farmer harvests & ships bulk produce in refrigerated transit to urban hub.
🏬 ❄️
2. Urban Cold Staging
Stored at TANFED Koyambedu (3,000 MT) or Basin Bridge (2,000 MT) under cold chain.
🛒 📲
3. Urban Consumer Orders
Chennai households order farm-fresh produce on AgriBRIDGE consumer app.
🛵 ➔ 🏠
4. Local Last-Mile Partner
Local EV delivery partner collects chilled crates and delivers to doorstep in 45 mins!

Official Policy Incentives

Tamil Nadu Government Subsidy & Loan Schemes for Cold Storages

Financial assistance available to farmers, FPOs, SHGs, and agri-entrepreneurs to construct modern cold chain infrastructure.

MIDH (State Horticulture Mission) 35% - 50% Subsidy
Nodal: TANHODA (Chepauk, Chennai) • Target: Up to 5,000 MT

Provides 35% subsidy in plains, 50% in hilly areas (Nilgiris, Kodaikanal). Covers multi-chamber cold storage units, solar micro cold rooms, and integrated pack houses.

NHB (National Horticulture Board) 35% - 45% Capital Subsidy
Nodal: National Horticulture Board • Target: 5,000 MT to 10,000 MT

Credit-linked back-ended capital subsidy based on normative cost. Requires strict technical insulation standards, energy efficiency, and ammonia/freon compliance.

PMKSY (Food Processing Ministry) Up to ₹10 Crore Grant
Nodal: MoFPI • Target: Integrated Cold Chains

35% to 50% capital grant for end-to-end farm-to-retail cold chain, including farm-gate pre-cooling, cold store units, and specialized reefer transport vans.

AIF (Agriculture Infrastructure Fund) 3% Interest Subvention
Nodal: Dept. of Agriculture • Target: Loans up to ₹2 Crore

3% interest subvention for 7 years plus CGTMSE collateral-free guarantee. Can be seamlessly combined with MIDH or NHB capital subsidies.

YELLOW – WATCH / மஞ்சள் – கண்காணிப்பு Official Warning Level 2 • Valid for next 48 Hours

Heavy Rainfall Watch (28–38 mm) in Delta Region / காவிரி டெல்டாவில் கனமழை வாய்ப்பு கண்காணிப்பு

Official IMD bulletin indicates localized heavy showers accompanied by thunderstorms on Friday evening. Soil saturation risks in low-lying samba paddy fields. Farmers are strongly advised to implement drainage precautions.

🛡️ Precautionary Agricultural Measures for Farmers / விவசாயிகளுக்கான முன்னெச்சரிக்கை நடவடிக்கைகள்

TNAU Agromet Verified
  • ✓ Avoid Fertilizer Spray: Postpone scheduled urea top-dressing until heavy showers subside to prevent nutrient leaching.
  • ✓ Field Drainage: Open drainage outlets and clear field bund trenches to allow rapid flood water runoff.
  • ✓ Protect Harvested Produce: Shift harvested paddy bags to covered threshing floors or regulated cold storage.
  • ✓ Machinery Safety: Park tractors, combine harvesters, and electric motor starters on elevated dry platforms.
  • ✓ Lightning Hazard: In open fields, strictly avoid taking shelter under isolated tall trees or high-voltage electric poles.
  • ✓ Banana Wind Propping: Provide sturdy bamboo/casuarina pole support for bunch-bearing banana plants against gusts.

High relative humidity (>78%) favors blast and fungal blight spore germination. Inspect nursery leaves and spray *Pseudomonas fluorescens* @ 10g/L during sunny windows.

Source: IMD Agromet & TNAU Plant Pathology Dept
